title: Couret — finite verifications
description: Reproducible finite computations for consecutive-square prime values, prime races modulo 30, and finite Fourier/Parseval closure checks. The repository distinguishes exact finite checks, floating-point finite checks, truncated numerical evaluations, and conditional or conjectural interpretations. No novelty claim is made for the mathematical mechanisms included in this release, and no named open problem is claimed to be resolved or advanced.
